resources.string: Ask anything. Everything stays on this device.

How random the answers are. Low = steady and precise (good for facts and code). High = varied and creative, but less reliable.
How wide a range of words the AI may pick from. Low = safe, predictable words only. 1.0 = any word. Usually leave this alone and change only Temperature.
Longest answer the AI can write. A token is roughly a word or a few characters.
How much of the conversation the AI remembers. Larger uses more memory and is slower.
Number of CPU threads used for generation. More is faster but uses more battery and heat. The default is half of the CPU cores.
Each AI model has its own license. Check the model\'s page on Hugging Face before using it.

Conversations with local models never leave your device.
Connects to a cloud AI. Your chat is sent to the provider.
Temperature, top-p and max tokens are also used for cloud models. Context length and threads apply to on-device models only.
Connect a cloud AI to use it from the model list next to your local models.
Usage is billed to you by each provider under your own contract. This app does not bill you.
Chat subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Gemini Advanced and similar) do not include API use. An API key is billed separately.

Delete this connection and its key from this device? Past messages stay.
The server address is not valid.
Only https:// addresses can be used. Plain http:// is not allowed, even on your own network.
You can select up to 10 models.

The display name must be 1 to 40 characters.

To use a cloud AI, sign in with your Google account. Your list of connections (without keys) is saved to the account, so it can be restored on another device. Local models do not need sign-in.
Sign-in requires Google Play services and a Google account on this device.
The connection list (without keys) is saved to your account. API keys stay on this device only.
Delete your account data for this app? The saved connection list on the server, and the connections and keys on this device, will be deleted. Your chat history stays.
No Google account was found, or Google Play services is not available on this device.
Could not connect. Check your network connection and try again.
Sign-in or account deletion failed. Please try again.
For security, please sign out, sign in again, and then retry deleting the account.
Sign in with Google first (Settings > API connections).
Show all models (including speech, image and embedding models)
Waiting for the response… (the model may be thinking) %1$d s
The response stopped partway (%1$d s without data)
Applies to the Google Gemini preset only. Lower values answer faster (useful when requests time out). Not available for every model.
The privacy policy could not be displayed.
How to request deletion without using the app
To request deletion without using the app, email %1$s from the Google account address you signed in with, and state that you want your data deleted. We will delete your account data from the server.

When you sign in, your email address and user ID are saved in Firebase (Google\'s authentication and database service), along with your list of connections (provider, display name, address and model names). API keys and your conversations are NOT saved there; keys stay only on this device. You can delete this data here after signing in ("Delete account and cloud data"), or without the app (see the Privacy Policy).
The conversation is getting long, so I\'m summarizing the older part…
Earlier messages are sent to the AI as a summary
The conversation got long, so the older part was summarized
Couldn\'t summarize, so older messages were left out
When a conversation gets long, older parts are summarized so it can continue. With cloud models this adds one extra request, which counts toward your API charges.

A local (on-device) model can list and read text files in the app\'s work folder, and create new files or replace existing ones. The folder is created by the app inside its private storage, so other apps cannot see it, and it is removed when you uninstall the app. The model cannot go outside the folder, delete files, handle binary files, or work with cloud models. Every write asks for your confirmation; reading and listing do not. You can view, share, export, or delete the files below. Files you share or export are outside the app\'s control. With both this and JavaScript enabled, a larger context length is recommended.
Let the AI use the work folder?
The AI will be able to read and write files in the app\'s work folder. This is not used with cloud models. Continue?
A new file will be created (%1$d bytes).
This replaces an existing file (now %1$d bytes → new %2$d bytes).

Stopped: the AI kept using the file tags incorrectly.
File contents from your work folder are not sent. However, the AI\'s replies or the summary may contain parts of them.
